facts.value: The International Office for Economics is the central contact point for all questions regarding studying abroad. The team of the International Office also supports exchange students from international partner universities who come to study in Frankfurt.

facts.value: Office hours are on Wednesdays from 9 - 11 AM, RuW 1.214. Office hours are cancelled until September 9, 2026. Inquiries during this time should be made via email at international@wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de.
